'''Tavia Kitik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who aided the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during a [[Marblewood Estate heist|complex heist]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

[[File:TaviaKitikCristoffHolo-Insider138.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tavia helps her sister steal from [[Cristoff]].]]
She was an electronics expert who preferred electronics fabrication to field work. The assistant of her ghost burglar twin sister, [[Bink Kitik|Bink]], Bink considered her the best groundliner she'd ever worked with, despite Tavia's disapproval of Bink's penchant for putting herself in dangerous situations.
